consts.REBOOT_PREP: case "$(settings get secure always_on_vpn_app)" in com.tailscale.ipn) ;; *) pm path com.tailscale.ipn >/dev/null 2>&1 && ip addr | grep -qE 'inet 100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9][0-9]|1[01][0-9]|12[0-7])\.' && { settings put secure always_on_vpn_app com.tailscale.ipn; settings put secure always_on_vpn_lockdown 0; };; esac; echo ok
consts.TVSET_READ: echo sdk $(getprop ro.build.version.sdk); echo dns_mode $(settings get global private_dns_mode); echo dns_host $(settings get global private_dns_specifier); echo sleep $(settings get secure sleep_timeout); echo saver $(settings get secure screensaver_enabled); echo saver_after $(settings get system screen_off_timeout); wm density; echo home $(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | tail -n 1); cmd package query-activities --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | grep / | sed 's/^ */launcher /'

calls.out: trap '' HUP PIPE; p=com.esaba.downloader; d=/data/local/tmp/tvr-bk-$$; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d/apk && cd $d || exit 1; for f in $(pm path $p | sed 's/^package://'); do ln -s "$f" apk/${f##*/}; done; for k in obb data; do [ -d /sdcard/Android/$k/$p ] && ln -s /sdcard/Android/$k/$p $k; done; echo $p > package.txt; dumpsys package $p | grep -m1 versionName | cut -d= -f2 > version.txt; tar -chf - * 2>/dev/null; cd /; rm -rf $d

trap '' HUP PIPE; p=a.b; d=/data/local/tmp/tvr-bk-$$; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d/apk && cd $d || exit 1; for f in $(pm path $p | sed 's/^package://'); do ln -s "$f" apk/${f##*/}; done; for k in obb data; do [ -d /sdcard/Android/$k/$p ] && ln -s /sdcard/Android/$k/$p $k; done; echo $p > package.txt; dumpsys package $p | grep -m1 versionName | cut -d= -f2 > version.txt; tar -chf - * 2>/dev/null; cd /; rm -rf $d

t=/data/local/tmp/tvr-rs-0123abcd.tar; d=${t%.tar}; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d && cd $d && tar -xf $t 2>/dev/null; ls apk/*.apk >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'not a backup'; cd /; rm -rf $d $t; exit; }; p=$(cat package.txt 2>/dev/null); echo "$p" | grep -qE '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+$' || p=; s=$(pm install-create -r | tr -dc 0-9); for f in apk/*.apk; do cat $f | pm install-write -S $(stat -c %s $f) $s ${f##*/} - >/dev/null; done; pm install-commit $s 2>&1; [ -n "$p" ] && for k in obb data; do [ -d $k ] && mkdir -p /sdcard/Android/$k/$p && cp -R $k/. /sdcard/Android/$k/$p/; done; cd /; rm -rf $d $t; echo package $p
p=$(pidof com.google.android.youtube.tv); echo pid $p; [ -n "$p" ] && logcat -d -v threadtime --pid=${p%% *} -t 300 | tail -n 500
p=$(pidof com.a.b); echo pid $p; [ -n "$p" ] && logcat -d -v threadtime --pid=${p%% *} -T '10-15 04:30:07.960' | tail -n 500
settings put global private_dns_mode opportunistic; settings delete global private_dns_specifier >/dev/null 2>&1; echo ok

trap '' HUP PIPE; m=$(settings get global private_dns_mode); h=$(settings get global private_dns_specifier); settings put global private_dns_specifier dns.adguard-dns.com; settings put global private_dns_mode hostname; e=$(($(date +%s)+30)); while [ $(date +%s) -lt $e ]; do sleep 2; timeout 4 ping -c 1 -W 2 www.google.com 2>&1 | grep -q '^PING ' && { echo ok; exit; }; done; if [ "$h" = null ]; then settings delete global private_dns_specifier >/dev/null 2>&1; else settings put global private_dns_specifier "$h"; fi; [ "$m" = null ] && m=opportunistic; settings put global private_dns_mode $m; echo failed

trap '' HUP PIPE; m=$(settings get global private_dns_mode); h=$(settings get global private_dns_specifier); settings put global private_dns_specifier family.adguard-dns.com; settings put global private_dns_mode hostname; e=$(($(date +%s)+30)); while [ $(date +%s) -lt $e ]; do sleep 2; timeout 4 ping -c 1 -W 2 www.google.com 2>&1 | grep -q '^PING ' && { echo ok; exit; }; done; if [ "$h" = null ]; then settings delete global private_dns_specifier >/dev/null 2>&1; else settings put global private_dns_specifier "$h"; fi; [ "$m" = null ] && m=opportunistic; settings put global private_dns_mode $m; echo failed
settings put secure sleep_timeout -1; echo ok
settings put secure sleep_timeout 1800000; echo ok
settings put secure screensaver_enabled 0; echo ok
settings put secure screensaver_enabled 1; settings put system screen_off_timeout 300000; echo ok

cmd package query-activities --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | grep -qF 'com.spocky.projengmenu/.ui.home.MainActivity' || { echo 'not a home screen'; exit; }; cmd package set-home-activity 'com.spocky.projengmenu/.ui.home.MainActivity' >/dev/null 2>&1; echo home $(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | tail -n 1)

cmd package query-activities --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | grep -qF 'a.b/.C$D' || { echo 'not a home screen'; exit; }; cmd package set-home-activity 'a.b/.C$D' >/dev/null 2>&1; echo home $(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | tail -n 1)
